review_findings.refusal_control: The all-rejected case removes flow_matrix from the later system_dynamics plan, asserts both ordered unsupported decisions and blocker reasons, no run/no trajectories/no authority, persists the typed refusal, and confirms the real numerical loader refuses it as joint_simulation_result_trajectory_missing.

review_findings.evidence: The former expected exception is replaced by the current API contract: both atom orders return the same typed unsupported decision/reason/blocker, engine_run_claimed=false, no trajectories and a no-run receipt. The monkeypatched execute_program_graph call count remains zero, so the conflict is refused before execution.

The stale interaction_evidence_incomplete expectation is replaced with the actual one-draw semantics: effect/comparator basis remains not_established; the request and seed denominator are one; per-step paired sampling reports standard_error_not_estimated with a null standard error; classification stays unsupported and authority is blocked. The assertion also requires no interaction-coverage or sampling issue, rather than silently accepting a fabricated zero error.

The test exercises actual selector, runner, persisted bytes and consumer validation; a content-bound simulation receipt is not treated as factual/world evidence. The source still marks comparator/effect/time truth not_established and the result keeps K_sim bounded. This review establishes neither external truth nor production capability closure.
